correctness.rationale: Aubry–Iezzi Proposition 5.2 forces normalization of 37-point maximal geometric-genus1 arithmetic-genus2 curve over F25 to be maximal genus1, exactly one F25-rational singularity of delta=1 whose preimage is a degree-two point. E:y^2=x^3+1 has 6 points/F5 and Frobenius over F25 equals [-5], so E(F25)=E[6] has36 and E(F625)=E[24] has576, giving 270 degree-two closed points. Supersingular j=0 twists of E over F25 have point counts 36 for only its one twist class. Every branch R has Delta=F(R)-R=[-6]R in nonzero E[4], and Aut_F25(E)=E[6]⋊mu6 acts on Delta. Mu6 acts in three orbits of sizes 3,6,6, leading to 270 closed points in 54,108,108 orbits and stabilizers 4,2,2; the order4 stabilizer is commuting involutions V4. Independently coded finite 24-torsion affine-orbit enumeration recovered [54,108,108].
